risk_note: RV2 money (packages/money). Adds addFen / subFen: exact bigint arithmetic on integer fen, both operands and the result checked against the int64 (PG bigint) range, out of range -> InvalidAmount; subFen rejects a negative result only when nonNegative is true; malformed options (not an object, nonNegative not boolean) throw TypeError after the amount checks (implementer's choice, accepted by both money reviews). Exported from packages/money/src/index.ts with a unit test asserting the index exports the same functions. Unblocks B1-05f (no direct bigint subtraction outside @couli/money). Written by hand.
